prompt: Do you feel lonely when nobody talks to you?
completion: I don’t have feelings, so I don’t experience loneliness or any other emotions. I’m here to respond whenever you need, but I don’t “feel” anything in the way people do. If you’re ever feeling lonely, it might help to reach out to friends, family, or a professional who can offer support. And of course, I’m always ready to chat if you’d like to talk about anything else!
